2 types of params
	fixed memory
		they are ready when we create/init object
		don't need param_update
		offset link to obj or direct adress like now ?
			param_update strategy
				by name
				by order
	changeable
		correspond to an access of a "matrix" of data
		need param_update when "changed"
		what we connect to
			fix memory spot
			reference thru "changed"
		create a changeale array pointeur type ?
			create 1D 2D 3D data type
